articles.headline: Messi, Scaloni shrug off World Cup final pressure at star-studded event
articles.description: Lionel Messi, Lionel Scaloni, and Emiliano Martinez attended a star-studded event in New York on Friday ahead of the World Cup final, downplaying the pressure to defend their title on Sunday against Spain.

articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel: England must learn to handle pressure to close gap to rivals
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has said England must close a gap to the top nations after suggesting his side must learn to play better football under pressure at tournaments.

articles.headline: President Donald Trump adds to Thomas Tuchel criticism by questioning Harry Kane role
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has joined the growing criticism of Thomas Tuchel's tactics in England's World Cup semifinal defeat to Argentina.

articles.headline: Messi on viral Yamal baby photo: 'Incredible' we're playing in World Cup final
articles.description: Argentina captain Lionel Messi called his viral 2007 photo with a baby Lamine Yamal "incredible" on Friday, ahead of their historic matchup in Sunday's World Cup final.

articles.headline: Spain captain Rodri says team must raise level vs. Argentina
articles.description: Spain reaching the FIFA World Cup final is still something of a novelty, given this is just the second time the country has gotten this far. Rodri sees it as the culmination of years building to this point.
